description: Use this when the user wants a printable calendar ("printable calendar", "2027 calendar printable", "monthly calendar template", "yearly calendar", "wall calendar", "school year calendar", "calendar with holidays") as a PDF. Builds a year on one page, a 12-month wall calendar with cover, a single month, or a month range up to 24 months, with public holidays for a country and state, custom birthdays and events, Monday or Sunday weeks, ISO week numbers, notes lines, paper size, language and an accent colour. Returns a preview and a PDF download link. Does not add events to Google, Outlook or Apple calendars, does not schedule meetings, and does not draw lunar, Hijri or Hebrew calendars.

accent.description: One accent colour for headings and holiday marks: a hex code like #0F766E or a name (indigo, blue, navy, teal, green, olive, red, crimson, pink, purple, orange, amber, brown, slate, gray, black). Default indigo.

bleed.description: Add a 0.125 in print bleed with trim marks in the PDF boxes, for professional printing. Default false.

country.description: Country for public holidays: ISO two-letter code or name, e.g. US, GB, DE, PL, FR, JP, BR, AU, CA. Omit for a calendar without holidays.

end.description: For layout range: last month as YYYY-MM (at most 24 months after start), e.g. 2027-06.

events.description: Custom events and birthdays (up to 60). Example: [{"date":"03-04","title":"Mom's birthday"},{"date":"2027-06-12","title":"Wedding"}]

date.description: MM-DD for every year (a birthday, e.g. 03-04) or YYYY-MM-DD for one date (e.g. 2027-05-14). "Mar 4" also works.

title.description: Short label drawn in the day cell, e.g. Mom's birthday.

holidays.description: Show public holidays when a country is given. Default true; false hides them.

include_observances.description: Also show observances, bank and optional days (e.g. Mother's Day, Valentine's Day, Christmas Eve). Default false: public holidays only.

language.description: Language for month and weekday names: en (default), pl, de, es, fr, it, pt, nl or ja. Holiday names use this language when the country's data has it, else English. Example: de

layout.description: year = whole year on one page; wall = 12-month wall calendar, a cover plus one month per page; month = one month on one page; range = one page per month from start to end (e.g. a school year). Example: wall

month.description: For layout month: the month as YYYY-MM, e.g. 2027-03.

notes.description: Add a ruled notes area under each month page (not on the one-page year). Default false.

orientation.description: Page orientation. Default landscape. Example: portrait

paper.description: Paper size: letter (8.5x11 in), a4, a3 or tabloid (11x17 in). Default letter for US/Canada/Mexico, a4 for other countries.

start.description: For layout range: first month as YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-08.

start_month.description: First month (1-12) for a 12-month year or wall calendar; 8 makes an August-to-July academic calendar. Default 1.

subdivision.description: Optional state, province or region for local holidays, e.g. TX or CA (US), BY (Bavaria, DE), SCT (Scotland), NSW (AU), ON (CA).

title.description: Optional title printed on the calendar, e.g. "Kowalski Family 2027". Default: the year or month.

week_numbers.description: Print ISO 8601 week numbers beside each week row. Default false. Example: true

week_start.description: First day of each week row. Default: the country's custom (Sunday for US, CA, BR, JP...; Monday for most of Europe); without a country, Sunday for English, Monday otherwise. Example: monday

year.description: Year for layout year or wall, e.g. 2027. Default: next year from October on, otherwise this year.

name: generate_calendar
title: Generate printable calendar
